sloka: ते तु इदानीम् जनस्थाने वसमाना महाबलाः ।संगताः परम आयत्ता रामेण सह संयुगे ॥३-३६-६॥
transliteration: te tu idānīm janasthāne vasamānā mahābalāḥ ।saṁgatāḥ parama āyattā rāmeṇa saha saṁyuge ॥3-36-6॥

translations.english: These mighty demons, living in Janasthana, eqipped with different kinds of weapons, supported and led by Khara, met Rama in an encounter.
translations.hindi: बे महाबली इन दिनों जनस्थान में रहते थे । वे राम के सार्थ जूम मरे
